newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bomb kills man in south Lebanon refugee camp.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills man in south Lebanon refugee camp.

text.p: A small bomb exploded in a Palestinian refugee camp in south Lebanon overnight, killing an unidentified man, security sources said on Wednesday.

The man was blown to pieces when the bomb exploded nearly two hours after midnight near a school in Ain el-Hilweh camp just outside the port of Sidon, 40 km (25 miles) south of Beirut, the sources said.
It was not immediately known who the man was and whether he was carrying the bomb or passing by when it went off, the sources said.

Inter-Palestinian feuds have claimed the lives of dozens of members of the various factions at the camp in recent years. Three guerrillas or former fighters were gunned down by masked gunmen in Ain el-Hilweh in January in three separate incidents.
